operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer template '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' (first parsable element) for all DATETIME cols; fresh dates uniform 1800..2100 unless elements constrain range
Number fuzzer on DECIMAL(19,4): scale=19 -> range +-10^19, so amount_* values wildly implausible vs original ~50-800 -> likely FN on range/aggregate predicates
Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs: +-1/+2 perturbation of sampled elements, plus fresh uniform in +-10^scale(0)=+-1 -> PKs cluster near 0/1, may collide -> PK dedup drops rows
String fuzzer on names: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0..80, contaminate 50% -> first_name/last_name become gibberish -> FN on LIKE/name predicates
String fuzzer on VARCHAR(1) gender/yn: fresh random strings length 0..1 from charset, not '0'/'1' -> breaks equality predicates -> FN

count_hired VARCHAR(40) int-like: String adds i+1/i-1 but also random strings -> mixed

Tiny parent tables (Products_for_Hire 5 rows) -> FK children only ever see <=5 distinct product_id -> joins trivially small
checked=False everywhere, p=0.2 default, 30% chance p=0 whole instance -> mostly fresh random values
